_comment: CDC scenario INITIAL LOAD: Db2 CDC over the ASN SQL-Replication CD tables the db2cdc system registers for every model table, asncap copying each change a moment after it commits; column names arrive upper-cased and are matched without case. The CD tables carry the rows an ON DELETE CASCADE takes but not an UPDATE that changes nothing: --cascades logged --noops unlogged. Db2 has no snapshot isolation, so an initial load under changes may load a change and replay it too. The stream starts over a seeded database: its initial load must be the database, and the changes after it the operations modify-data applied. STAGES: (1) domains -- create the db2cdc domain, install employeescdc, load the xs seed, its operations appended to ${xp:dir}/ops.jsonl; (2) actions, tagged live -- `sentinel-data --key after-create-data`, so the load carries a key; (3) collections and (4) functions -- register db2cdc_initial_load (initial_load=True), which STARTS it; (5) sentinel -- hold until after-create-data arrives: the load has flushed; (6) actions, tagged live -- one `modify-data --ops Mix --sets 5` pass, then `sentinel-data --key after-changes`; (7) sentinel; (8) actions, tagged check -- scripts/verify_cdc_ops.py --start initial-load: the snapshot is the state the seed left, the changes after it one by one, in the same transactions, each with its whole before-image and the row it leaves; nothing of audit; (9) monitor. Generated by gen_suites.py. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite cdc/db2cdc_initial_load --keep`.
